decision: Keep offline. With the same initial paths and matched work, continuous scores add no accepted candidates and do not improve mean mask disagreement relative to hard-mask continuation. Do not promote confidence-only refinement or add this continuation to the ten-second pipeline.

controls.selection: Original mask and full paper audit at each checkpoint; no finish() repairs. Every raw result retained, including small regressions from the seed.

findings.finding: Flower: confidence improves the independent error from the seed 4.433% to 3.673%, versus hard continuation 4.396%. False channels near the center and border defects remain; two source features are still missing.

Three wise men: holding the six-cut start prevents the large star loss seen in the previous full confidence search. Neither arm fully recovers the star; hard loses one measured feature, confidence two.
Wolf: neither continuation resolves the starting paper problem. The earlier accepted full-confidence fit is therefore not reproduced by confidence refinement alone from this fixed hard start.
Octopus: most existing tentacles remain, but fine curls are still missing and both results remain just above the original 3% disagreement limit.
Woman/bird and bear: extra work improves bulk silhouettes, but does not recover fine faces, bird shapes or the isolated fish visible in the photos.
Single heart: the small top seam disappears in both continuations; both retain acceptance.
Printed ink remains confused with the sheet material in the fixed masks. Additional curve refinement cannot repair that classification target.
The oblique filled basket and reflective building retain visibly wrong fixed crops. Confidence-only refinement does not correct crop geometry.

conclusions: All twelve engine and editable passes have exactly the same identities as the initial hard-control fits. All six unresolved crops remain in the 32-photo denominator.

Hard continuation lowers mean independent disagreement from 3.529% to 3.325%; confidence continuation reaches 3.334%. This costs extra work after the initial search, rather than establishing a faster policy.
Local confidence forces can improve an individual silhouette, but this matched-start experiment finds no cohort-wide advantage or new accepted result.
The earlier full-confidence wolf gain and three-wise-men regression depended on a different search trajectory; this result does not identify which individual routing change caused the wolf gain.

The remaining defects include crop failure, printed-paper classification, missing fine details and paper support. A single confidence temperature or longer local optimization does not address all of them.

validation.applicationChecks: Base local QA passed type checking, lint, all 2401 application tests and build; base CI passed all four inverse correctness shards and deployment. Current lint exits zero with seven existing warnings. New work is offline experiment/review/audit code and documentation.
validation.scope: Field reconstruction, candidate rendering, source-feature checks, engine geometry, guarded paper and editable exports all audited; structural controls test shared parameter identity separately from coincident coordinates.

limitations: These are repeatedly inspected development photos, not an untouched holdout.
Disagreement measures estimated two-color targets, not unavailable original artwork or ground-truth cuts.
Fixed topology can limit recovery; this is not a test of all possible NN-guided path proposals.
All initial pairs differ between sheets, so the optional identical-sheet preservation branch is not exercised here.
Geometry and paper checks are nominal computational checks, not physical assembly tests.
Raw candidate errors can worsen slightly after continuation; retaining every proposal avoids silently reporting only improvements.
Do not compare extra refinement seconds with a full end-to-end ten-second solve budget.
nextDirection: Investigate missing material boundaries and structural proposals, with explicit supervision and independent full-pipeline checks, rather than tuning confidence temperature or iteration counts against these same 32 photos.
